correctness.rationale: For smooth characteristic p not 2 or 5, the Cartier-Manin coefficient rule puts four entries at a permutation of columns; reciprocity identifies opposite rows in pairs with coefficient zero sets A_p and B_p. A coefficient-recurrence ODE proves both polynomials squarefree away from boundary, and the general two-pair rank formula yields a=0,2,4 and exact geometric counts. In p=23, binomial expansions factor A_23 and B_23 over F23 into one linear and six separate irreducible quadratics, all tested and symbolically checked by the standalone code. Inversion pairing gives the degree-seven squarefree moduli equation. A single four-cycle in Frobenius makes every rank-two Cartier specialization p-rank zero; proofs apply to all algebraically closed fields of indicated characteristic. Finite tests verify but do not establish universal claims.
